North Korea Accused of Sending Workers to Russia for Arms Production

North Korea is reportedly sending 25,000 additional citizens to Russia to support its war industry, specifically in the production of drones and weapons. This move has been linked to Kim Jong-un's efforts to bolster his nation's power. Meanwhile, Kim Yo Jong, sister of Kim Jong-un, has accused the United States of escalating tensions on the Korean Peninsula through multinational military exercises with South Korea and Japan, stating these drills push North Korea towards nuclear arms growth. The New York Times highlights the potential hidden human cost of these actions.
